title: Jack Laine's band and light-skinned musicians passing as white
summary: Russell says some light-skinned musicians passed for white. Souchon recalls Tom Brown's slur against Laine and wonders about others, including Yellow Nunez.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Well he said he had some light colored fellows like Bach Kay and his band. And they passed for white. Yeah a few of those. Sure.

That's what Tom Brown was so ugly about. He said that old nigger he referred to Jack as a nigger. Because I'm sure he knew and Tom played with those boys too. There were two of them. Was it Rag Baby Steven?
Wasn't he? I don't know. I don't think I ever heard him say that.
Well now wait. That was Yellow Nunes.
